The best move is **Qh7+** (forcing check):
- After Qh7+, the Black king must move to f8 (only legal move; h8 is controlled by the Queen)
- Then Qh8# is checkmate (the king has no escape squares)

**Coaching Note:**
When your opponent's king looks vulnerable and you have multiple attacking pieces nearby, look for forcing moves—checks especially. Here, pushing the queen to h7 with check forces the king into a mating net. The rook on g6 and queen work together to control all escape squares. Always calculate one move ahead to see if a forcing move leads to decisive advantage.
